text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Ever since her hands-on customer service training at the ramen shop last time, Meisho Doto had been diligently practicing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since then, she seemed to keep studying customer service whenever she found the time. Meanwhile—
choice_data_list: I'm getting a little hungry... Let's head into this place.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Welcome!!
...Wait, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is the perfect chance to show the fruits of my customer service training—
All right, bring it on, pleash!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Deryaaaa!!
Special Move: Godspeed Menu Handout!!
choice_data_list: Uh, um, so then this is... !?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Comiiiing right up!
One special ramen order in progress!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Cold water slide!! Wet towel set!!
Garlic recharge!!
And then, and then—!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh!?
Trainer-san, why do you look so exhausted...!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
C-Could it be... because my customer service
is still lacking!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
In that case—training!! Training is the only answer!!
I-I will try even haaaarder!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I know she's trying hard, but it feels like she's losing her way.
To give her a breather,
I decided to take her to a certain place."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"So this is the shop Trainer recommended,
known for its high-level customer service.
I'm trembling with excitement...!"

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Hey, welcome!
Party of two, is the counter okay for you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
I'll do my best to learn from thish!!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: ...You seem pretty fired up, customer. Well, just let me know whenever you're ready to order~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Through sight, through sound—
I shall absorb customer service skills with all five of my senses...!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Here's your order. Two bowls of ramen and...
here, one carrot juice.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
I-I didn't order any juice, though?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, it's on the house, on the house.
Just a little something extra, you know?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah. I-It's delicious...!
Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I'm glad. It seems your mind is at ease now.
Now then, take your time and savor it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why the shopkeeper... gave us
that extra service on the house?
choice_data_list: I just want you to enjoy eating it. That's all.
I just want you to enjoy eating it. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"...Now you should be able to understand the taste of ramen.
Here... miso ramen and salt ramen."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee. The food was delicious, it was clean, and the atmosphere was so warm and friendly...
It was a truly wonderful shop.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And besides, somehow... it feels like we took a huge detour
...only to end up right back where we started.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I had convinced myself that
training at various shops and seeing different techniques
...was the single most important thing.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Still... true 'sincerity' is
surely something much simpler, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want the customers to eat ramen at its most delicious, with a happy heart.
That wish came out so naturally.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. I... won't let what I've learned
in my training go to waste.
But... from now on, with sincerity as my true foundation—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To make sure it's true hospitality...
I'll do my besht!
